title: Population Structure Analysis of an Inbred Population using Quantitative Shape Phenotyping from Stereo Retinal Photographs
abstract: arXiv:2608.15471v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The population structure of an inbred population of 781 people on Norfolk Island in the Pacific, 318 of which are descendants of the original Mutineers of the Bounty, is analyzed phenotypically using shape from stereo retinal fundus photographs. Three-dimensional optic nerve head (ONH) shape is reconstructed from stereo pairs by a multi-scale stereo matching algorithm. Using deep neural network, the shape of ONH, which is under genetic control, is decomposed into a set of hierarchical features through self-taught learning. Features captured at different levels are selected according to their discriminant power in identifying the two populations. The prediction accuracy is evaluated with stratified cross validation. Given the selected feature set, individuals are grouped into k hierarchical clusters and cluster membership fractions are determined for k=2,3,4,5,6,7. translated_title: 利用立体视网膜照片的定量形状表型分析近交人群的群体结构
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.15471v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对太平洋诺福克岛上781人的近交人群的群体结构进行了表型分析，其中318人是邦蒂号叛变者原始后裔。通过多尺度立体匹配算法，从立体眼底照片中重建三维视神经头（ONH）形状。利用深度神经网络，通过自学习将受遗传控制的ONH形状分解为一组层次化特征。根据区分两个人群的判别能力，选择不同层次捕获的特征。使用分层交叉验证评估预测准确性。给定所选特征集，将个体划分为k个层次聚类，并确定k=2,3,4,5,6,7时的聚类成员比例。通过图像分析基于表型进行群体结构分析。
tldr: 本文通过立体视网膜照片重建三维视神经头形状，并利用深度神经网络的自学习特征进行层次聚类，实现了对近交人群群体结构的表型分析。
en_tdlr: This paper reconstructs 3D optic nerve head shape from stereo retinal photos and uses deep neural network self-learned features for hierarchical clustering, enabling phenotypic population structure analysis of an inbred population.
